# Apple DNS Profile Creator

> A client-side tool that generates encrypted-DNS (DoH and DoT) configuration
> profiles for iOS and macOS (iOS27 and MacOS27). Everything happens in the browser: no data is
> uploaded, and the tool works fully offline, making it suitable for hosting
> on a home network. Apple has supported DNS-over-HTTPS and DNS-over-TLS
> since iOS 14 and macOS 11, but exposes no way to use them without an app
> or a configuration profile — this tool builds those profiles.

Links:

- [The Tool]: {{ site }}
  Create or import encrypted-DNS configuration profiles. Enter resolver
  settings by hand, or upload an existing .mobileconfig (signed profiles
  work too — embedded settings are read directly).
- [Finalize / Download]: {{ site }}finalize.html
  Review the collected configurations and download the finished profile.
- [GitHub Repository]: https://github.com/tofulupo/apple-dns-profile-creator
  Source code, build instructions, and documentation.
- [Project Documentation]: https://github.com/tofulupo/apple-dns-profile-creator#readme
  Architecture overview, ways to run the tool, and developer setup.

Optional:

- [Advanced options]: On the tool page, resolver addresses may be entered
  one per line or comma-separated, in any mix of IPv4 and IPv6 (tried in
  the order given). Advanced settings include disabling encrypted DNS on
  specified Wi-Fi SSIDs or domains, restricting encrypted DNS to listed
  domains only, falling back to the network's resolver when the encrypted
  server is unreachable (iOS/macOS/visionOS 26+), and preventing profile
  removal on supervised devices.
- [Profile signing]: Profiles from the website are NOT signed. Unsigned
  profiles install identically; iOS and macOS merely label them "Not Signed"
  during installation. The macOS desktop app can optionally sign them with a
  certificate from the user's Keychain.
